notes.title: Build Update - Chapter 2 Test Levels - News
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340538/d7f954344a8cf3267d85b9534ccd6a4f09c3ee07.jpg"]
🏝️CHANGELIST — v0.8.4.4 September 12, 2025[p align="start"]NEW FEATURES

On-screen messages now appear when saving from vehicles,

On-screen messages now appear when dying, and when drowning your car engine,

The compass is now fully functional while driving,

MELEE COMBAT: Brittany can now defend herself using her fists or her currently equipped weapon,

A new male character has joined Studio Mode and will soon appear on the Island,

Brittany’s health bar is now visible. Entering combat will briefly interrupt her health regeneration,
[p align="start"]Test Levels (WIP, subject to change)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340538/51ce4995c171647a34dcd3cb7851cb3d97a02677.png"]

Locking and unlocking devices,

Colored keys system,

Three different projectile traps,

Melee attacking various objects,

Trap persistence,

Damage testing,

Destruction and physics reactions,

Enemies with different behaviors and types,

Enemy waves spawner testing,


[p align="start"]🔜 INCOMING FEATURES

Work on GPU procedurally generated grass for optimization and look improvement,

More polished death sequence (fade to black, death reason, audio…),

Combat system improvements — lots of progress on that front!,

Environmental traps (sneak peeks coming soon!),

Interactive activation/deactivation devices (levers, pressure plates, targets…),

Extended inventory and object pick up system,

Water vehicles,

Improved vaulting,

Phone interface to call for services (e.g. towing your car),

Enemy variations,
[p align="start"]🛠️BUG FIXES Story Mode

Fixed Futa settings not updating characters properly,

Fixed picking Trinity turning her blonde on game start,

Various minor dialogue script fixes,

Fixed Marcia not spawning in the car at the start of the Scenic Overlook quest,

Fixed “Game Saved” message staying on screen when reloading from the main menu,

Loop button during cutscenes now works correctly,

Fixed cutscene UI not animating properly,

Fixed sex audio not pausing when pausing cutscenes,

Fixed map markers not persisting correctly when reloading multiple times,

Improved skeleton skinning,

Improved test level icons,
[p align="start"]STUDIO MODE

Fixed third character not orgasming in threesomes (embodiment of third wheeling ),
[p align="start"]⚠️KNOWN ISSUES

Quest log update consistency is being monitored, but is likely fixed with the latest vehicle attachment changes,

Physics can be chaotic — the character’s physical strength can cause excessive projection and heavy fall damage,

Vaulting can push the character inside collision and get them stuck (WIP)
[p align="start"]---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[p align="start"]Progress on Chapter 2 is amazing to be honest. Since we have so many Systems in place, we can now start adding content a lot easier. It will also be even faster in the future.
[p align="start"]We have a nice Timelapse Video of a Level Blockout here, in case you are interested


[previewyoutube="xHo9jTdEIKc;full"][/previewyoutube]

Our Marketing also came up with a nice Announcement:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340538/daf5d3905ef7af125f4bc05d5f8c1fbe1c7b986e.jpg"]
Sensual Adventures: Treasure Island - Chapter 2 Free Expansion Pack [p align="start"]We’re excited to announce that development for Chapter 2 of Sensual Adventures: Treasure Island has officially begun!
[p align="start"]Building on the success of the first chapter we’re taking things to the next level. Chapter 2 will expand Treasure Island with new gameplay features, thrilling dungeons, terrifying zombies, explosive combat, and challenging puzzles that push the series into new territory.
[p align="start"] What to Expect

More sensual and naughty scenes that will have you playing with one hand

Fresh environments to explore, from dark temples to maze-like dungeons

New enemies including zombies and creatures that await inside the temple

Expanded gameplay like shooting, explosives, traps, wall climbing and puzzle-solving

A larger adventure that appeals to fans of FPS, horror, dungeon crawlers, and adventure-puzzle games
[p align="start"]Release Window
Chapter 2 is targeting a Winter 2025/2026 release, with more details and gameplay previews dropping along the way.
[p align="start"]Last Call For Early Access!
This will be the last call for early access Chapter 1 and the price will go up for Chapter 2. This is a FREE expansion pack so lock in your lower price today.
[p align="start"]Be Part of the Journey
As development progresses, we’ll share behind-the-scenes content, concept art, and early gameplay snippets. Community feedback will be vital so sign up to our email list,  join the conversation on Discord, and follow us on social media to be part of shaping the next adventure.
[p align="start"]This is just the beginning. Treasure Island: Chapter 2 is coming bigger, bolder, and more thrilling than ever.

notes.title: Customization - Stage 1 🥳
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340538/5513d554ec28f83367d83c57c686627d2aa809ba.jpg"]

Hey everyone,

Today's Update is all about the first stage of customisation 😎
[previewyoutube="FJPemuDYwlo;full"][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube="aKpTDKtH5F0;full"][/previewyoutube]
It is still work in Progress and, as mentioned before, we will ship in multiple Stages.

Let's get started!
Customization - Stage 1:
We started with Body Customisation and some very basic Cloth selection.

And you can run around completely naked, as so many of you requested 😉😊

What we have so far:

Colour Change:
- Skin
- Eyes
- Hair
- Eyelashes
- Outfits
- Strapon

New Eye Shader:
The new Shader not only allows for cool things like changing Colour and Pupil size, but also mimics Real-Life Eyes a lot better.

Fitness, Metalness, Wetness

Makeup:
That´s a big one for me, and I am super happy to have it. You can not only change the colour, but also the Specularity and Metalness. So if you want to have glittering Eyeshadows/Makeup, you can do that 🥳

Lips:
But not just the general colour, also different Styles! ☺️

Outfits:
- Shirts
- Pants
- Bickini/Dickini
- Shoes

Strapon/Dick Mode
Upcoming Features for Customisation:
Reset to Default

Many, many more Outfits 😎

Presets: so you can quickly switch between different Styles

Customisation for Studio Mode Characters
Optimization:
While implementing the first stage of Customisation, we also optimised the playable Characters a lot. The character is now around 5x less complex, which makes everything smoother. This change has not yet been applied to all the NPC,s but we will do that also which will improve the performance even more.
Bugfixes:
Fixed being able to save and load when in a phone call preventing regaining input.

Fixed a bug in Joe and Barbie sequence sometimes stalling
Known Issues:
You can´t use old savegames

Cutscenes that modify the character (adding a strapon, removing clothings..) will apply the customization afterwards on the character.

New customization system is not extended to NPCs (the ones out in the world) and not all cutscenes have been updated to it. This will be resolved shortly!

T-posing in water when exiting dialogues in some instances

Save and load issues, multiple notification sounds firing, quest logs acting up...

Game not Pausing when you are in Customisation Menu

notes.title: Engine Upgrade - Improved Performance & Visuals, Hotfix
notes.content:
Today, we are very happy to give you an update of Treasure Island for the full Version AND the Demo 🥳

We performed another Engine Update (we are on the latest 5.6 now), and the performance and visual Quality are both significantly better! 

There was also one Engine Bug in 5.5 that caused hard crashes. So that is fixed with the Upgrade to 5.6 as well! 

The perfect example for better visuals are the way better looking. There is no more noisy flickering of the shadows. That actually also improved a lot indoors. The general look improved a lot overall. And we finally made the Pool stuff float 😋


[previewyoutube="GzjJslrvt4U;full"][/previewyoutube]
We have not had the chance to change the Gras (and some other things) with a more optimised version, but that, in Combination with customisation and Combat, will be tackled next. But just with the Engine Upgrade we get, on average, around 10 frames more. Looking better and running faster is pretty amazing.


Changelist:
New Features: 

We have upgraded Unreal Engine version to 5.6, new tools and base performance is increased. Major Crash bug from Unreal 5.5 is also resolved. 

Physics objects by the pool will now float in the water. 

Bugfixes: 

Fixed hair texture quality 

Reduced footsprints sizes 

Aligned dialogue Speaker Name with the UI 

Refill ammo when starting a shooting range 

Sunbaths display tutorials and choice again 

Attempt at fixing achivements not unlocking 

You can now use camera system on the Island in Studio mode 

Quality of Life Improvements: 

Quick Load is now on F10 by default. We decided to do that so you don´t hit the wrong key by accident because they were too close to each other. 

It is now easier to interact with NPCs and collectables because the detection radius increased

Improved car controller input 

Known issues : 

Some NPCs can have an initialisation bug. Going away from them far and coming back can fix the issue 

Some Gameplay-Animations can be a bit off, will be fixed in the next update

If your system runs out of Texture Memory, weird Squares can show up on the Terrain. Reducing the Texture quality in Video Settings should help.

Crash upon loading saved game from main menu. Loading save game repeatedely gradually degrades the game, restarting helps. 

You can´t re-use Savegames from previous Versions

Incoming features: 

We are progressing a lot on the customization system. 

More optimisations (current optimisations come out of the box from engine upgrades, we have a lot of room for improvement!)

Proper Localisation for Chinese & Korean (Japanese is already done and with proper Quality)

Lovense integration. Oh yeah! 😉

notes.title: Engine Upgrade - Trinity - Lots of improvements!
notes.content:
What's new:


 Added Trinity as playable Character 🥳
 Upgraded Unreal Engine version to 5.5.4 (latest), this should improve performance and stability out of the box especially for lower end devices.
 Temporary disabled DLSS until we update it to the newest version. It will be back as soon as we finish more testing. 
 Added automated detection of Video Settings at the very start, before you enter a Game-Mode. 
 Added Steam achievements integration (with the first batch of test achievements)
 Added Trinity to the character selection
 Added more Save and Load options to the story mode (open the pause menu to manually save,load,delete save files)
 Improved Auto-detect settings and added a pop-up to trigger it when starting a new game.
 Update of the ocean simulation to its newest version.
 Added gamepad support to the car



Bugfixes:


 Fixed loss of input when loading game while in a dialogue
 Fixed an erectile dysfunction problem when pressing the climax button (how anti climatic!)
 Fixed Brittany and Trinity's names being translated in some languages in dialogues
 Fixed money being added when buying first aid kit Fixed Carmen hair not being simulated Fixed Carmen's ... Bits poking out
 Fixed sound not resuming at the end of playing a movie in Studio Mode
 Fixed a critical crash when saving and loading in Studio Mode
 Fixed dropped weapons not being saved
 Fixed a sunbathing cutscene where it was ignoring the character selection choice



Know Issues:


 Loading the game multiple times in the same instance of a game (never restarting the game) gradually breaks the game. If you experience the game breaking, restarting and loading might help. We are investigating the right way to fix this.
 Improper character physics (Superpowers to push the car etc)
 Rare instance of T-Posing when exiting a dialogue in water
 Savegames from previous Versions don´t work

notes.title: Update: Treasure Island - 8.1.3 - Full Version & Demo
notes.content:
Hey, today we proudly present a new version of Treasure Island - 8.1.3

Please note, Trinity will be available in the next update (in around 2 weeks)

Features and Bugfixes:


 Studio Mode: Save and load improvements, you should be able to set up a scene, props and cameras and retain the state and settings upon saving and loading and play the movie right away.
 Car: We now have an Arcade-Style approach by default, but you can switch to a more realistic one in the Settings. I really like the Arcade mode 😊
 Multiple bugs were fixed with the Car (floating, orientation...) . And you can now go to the menu when driving the car! I missed that a lot.
 Optimisations: We have made a first pass on optimisations for better settings detection, memory handling, and some optimisations on the island. After a lot of profiling, we found a couple of major culprits that were very easy to fix. For example, the Flag on the Post-Office caused the Performance to tank when you were on the Town Square... Such a tiny thing causing that much trouble... 🫠
 Proper Japanese Translation
 You can enter the menu when you are in Dialogues
 Some male could be replaced by female in studio mode when they shouldn't
 Auto Detection for Graphics Settings now works a lot better! We did some intense testing with as many Hardware configurations as we could get our hands on.
 We added another Pose with Guys to Studio Mode (Reverse Cowgirl)
 Various smaller bugfixes


Known Issues:


 DLSS 4: still Work-In-Progress. We had/still have a bit to rework the whole "Game Detects what Specs you have". But the good thing is that we can then also plug in the AMD/ATI Equivalent of DLSS a lot easier. We will most likely have that implemented next Week. That will also increase the performance!
 Quest logs are not updating properly
 Possible save and load inconsistencies
 The car does not interact with water yet
 T-posing in water after dialogues on rare occasions.
 Rare occasions of not being able to advance the dialogue.


Misc/Upcoming:


 We consider Chapter 1 pretty much done now and will start upgrading to the newer Version of the Unreal Engine (5.5.4 to be precise). That´s going to be a very big chunk of work, but it will also help a great deal with better Performance & new Features (customisation!).
 Things that will be added overall to the game, and appear also in Chapter 1, will also be added soon. For example, some Tourists wandering around would be nice. And that you can have Sex with them🥰And more Animals (Land & Sea)!
 And of course: starting with Chapter 2 Development!

notes.title: Update 8.1.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340538/d690201e16a770dcce0951cf779a39da61bba02f.jpg


Here is the complete list! As you can see we have been very busy! 💪😊

Features:


 You can now rest in Brittany's bedroom to pass time by interacting with the bed
 Added Futa/Female game setting choice at the start of the game
 Futas will have their bits visible at all times everywhere they should be, and Females will have it replaced by strap-on when genitals are required, and nothing when no genitals are required.
 Added ability to change futa setting from game menu.
 First implementation of save/load in studio mode (Work in progress!) : ten slots which you can save / overwrite / delete. Ability to load different levels. Option to start new or load from main menu.
 First implementation of the new car : much more optimized, can be saved and loaded, and we have more control over it. (Work in progress!)
 You can now use the button on bottom left to enable/disable the gizmo to move things around in Studio Mode.
 Damage numbers now show up. Added settings to show/hide damage numbers and score numbers.


Bugfixes:


 Fixed some localisation issues.
 Fixed a bug where score and timer would not properly display if you did multiple quests involving them.
 Fixed player orientation sometimes being wrong when starting a dialogue.
 Fixed a rare bug that could prevent advancing dialogue if you restarted it too quickly after finishing one. Raised swimming pool surface level.
 Fixed a bug creating duplicate quest logs. Fixed Lonna questlines persistency. Improved her dialogue fluidity. It's now easier to find out you can hunt with her, and you can start the hunting quest over and over.
 Fixed a duplicate dialogue leftover at the temple entrance
 Fixed Aisha's presence at the Muddler not being saved. You can now date her multiple times.
 Fixed Aisha scene stalling/freezing
 Fixed Basil disappearing if you load the game during the investigation scene.
 Fixed duplicate Jenny if you bang her with the bathroom door open. Fixed a rock missing collision on the island.


Known issues:


 Save and load in studio : animations out of sync (switching character fixes it), some settings not carrying over, camera system and movies not accounted for.
 Save and load in game : still some bugs reported being progressively tackled. New team members on board to better approach the process. The more you use the save and load, the louder the notifications for quests. Working on it
 T-posing in water after dialogues in rare occasions.
 Can't enter Menu when driving the Car

notes.title: Update 8.1.1
notes.content:
This is a non exhaustive list, as some smaller things got changed on the way


 You can advance dialogue with spacebar again. Added a small delay to prevent selection a choice by accident by skipping too quickly.
 Localization: Russian and Ukrainian languages are now both supported. Fixed some symbols not displaying for some languages.
 Controller and MKB focus issues should be resolved : Redesign of the buttons for dialogue choices. Fixed a bug that wouldn't let MKB rebind mappable keys.
 Fixed a bug that would move the camera down until crouching when coming out of swimming.
 Flower quests now all reward you with money.
 Fixed some positions not having audio.
 Main quest : You will now get kicked outside of the temple if you are inside during closing hours. Improvement to save and load.
 Studio Mode : Fixed some positions shooting out during climax when there was nothing to shoot from.
 Fixed an issue with out of quest bounds widget not disappearing when completing a quest outside the bounds.
 Fixed Aisha cutscenes freezing the game in some instances. Keep an eye out for more cutscenes doing that!
 Muddler night event : Improvement to the save and load, fixed the drinks not being coutned in some instances.


 Known issues : 


 You can have louder sounds for starting, progressing or completing quests if you use the save and load a lot. We are working on it!
 Car : The car is going under a complete overhaul for us to have our own system and be ready to have fun customizable various vehicles. Bear with us while it's buggy (can;t be saved, weapons floating etc)
 Damage numbers do not show up in the game when they show up in engine.
